universal.zh: 手排箱裡有兩根平行的軸：輸入軸接離合器，輸出軸接傳動軸。每個檔位是一對常嚙合的齒輪，由同步器決定哪一對「鎖上」輸出軸。齒數比不同，扭力和轉速就不同。
universal.en: A manual gearbox has two parallel shafts: the input shaft from the clutch and the output shaft to the driveshaft. Each gear is a constantly meshed pair; a synchroniser decides which pair is locked to the output. Different tooth counts give different torque and speed.

specific.zh: F30 320i N20 的手排是 ZF 製的 GS6-17BG（料號 23007633989，社群來源）。齒比待查證。變速箱油是終身油，但多數人建議 10 萬公里左右換一次。
specific.en: The F30 320i N20 manual is the ZF-built GS6-17BG (part no. 23007633989, community source). Ratios unverified. The oil is "lifetime fill", but most owners change it around 100,000 km.

fasteners.desc: 鐘形殼對引擎螺絲 / Bellhousing-to-engine bolts

warnings.zh: 退出時保持水平，不要讓重量掛在輸入軸上，會弄彎離合器片。
warnings.en: Pull it straight back; never let its weight hang on the input shaft or the clutch disc bends.

commonIssues.zh: 入檔困難、打齒：通常是同步器磨損或離合器沒完全分離。
commonIssues.en: Hard shifting or grinding: usually worn synchronisers or a clutch that does not fully release.

note.zh: 一般認為是 BMW MTF LT-3，請以原廠資料為準
note.en: Commonly stated as BMW MTF LT-3; confirm with BMW data

name.zh: 分離軸承與同心式分泵

universal.zh: 踩離合器時，分泵推動分離軸承去壓壓板的彈簧指，離合器才會分開。軸承讓「不轉的推力」可以壓在「在轉的壓板」上。
universal.en: When you press the pedal, the slave cylinder pushes the release bearing against the pressure plate fingers to release the clutch. The bearing lets a non-rotating push act on a spinning plate.

specific.zh: BMW 用同心式分泵（CSC）：分泵套在輸入軸上，和分離軸承做成一體，裝在鐘形殼裡。換離合器時一定順便換它，因為要再拆一次變速箱才碰得到。
specific.en: BMW uses a concentric slave cylinder (CSC) around the input shaft, built into the release bearing inside the bellhousing. Always replace it with the clutch, since reaching it again means pulling the gearbox.

warnings.zh: 裝回後離合器油路要排空氣。
warnings.en: Bleed the clutch hydraulics after refitting.

commonIssues.zh: CSC 漏油：踏板變軟、沉到底、無法入檔。
commonIssues.en: Leaking CSC: soft or sinking pedal, cannot select gears.

universal.zh: 從離合器片接進來的軸，前端是花鍵、尾端是一顆常嚙合齒輪帶動副軸。
universal.en: The shaft driven by the clutch disc: splined at the front, with a constant-mesh gear at the rear driving the countershaft.

specific.zh: 輸入軸前端插進飛輪中心的導軸承。裝變速箱時要對準花鍵，所以離合器片要先用校正棒對中。
specific.en: The nose rides in a pilot bearing in the flywheel. The splines must line up on refit, which is why the clutch disc is centred with an alignment tool first.

universal.zh: 變速箱最後面的殼，裝著輸出軸尾端的軸承與油封。拆開它才能把軸抽出來。
universal.en: The rearmost casing, holding the output shaft bearing and seal. It comes off before the shafts can slide out.

specific.zh: 模擬器把它當作「打開變速箱」的入口：拆了尾殼，內部的軸、齒輪、同步器才拆得下來。實際翻修順序以手冊為準。
specific.en: The simulator treats it as the door into the gearbox: once it is off, the shafts, gears and synchronisers can come out. Follow the manual for the real rebuild order.

universal.zh: 變速箱的出口，傳動軸用三顆或四顆螺絲鎖在這個法蘭上。
universal.en: The gearbox outlet; the driveshaft bolts to this flange.

specific.zh: 拆傳動軸（P4）時從這裡分開。法蘭螺帽通常是一次性（待查證）。
specific.en: The driveshaft (P4) separates here. The flange nut is usually single-use (unverified).

fasteners.desc: 輸出法蘭螺帽 / Output flange nut

universal.zh: 排檔桿透過連桿或拉索，推動變速箱裡的撥叉。
universal.en: The gear lever moves the selector forks inside the gearbox through a linkage or cables.

specific.zh: F30 的排檔桿直接裝在變速箱上方（直接換檔），所以手感直接。拆變速箱前要從車內拆開排檔桿。
specific.en: On the F30 the lever sits directly on top of the gearbox (direct shift), giving a direct feel. It is detached from inside the car before the gearbox comes out.

universal.zh: 撥叉卡在同步器套筒的溝槽裡，排檔時把套筒往左或往右推。
universal.en: The forks sit in the grooves of the synchroniser sleeves and push them left or right when you shift.

specific.en: Three forks serve 1-2, 3-4 and 5-6.

universal.zh: 齒輪一直在轉，要「咬」上輸出軸前，轉速得先一樣。同步器用一個錐形摩擦環先把齒輪拖到同速，再讓套筒的犬齒卡進去。
universal.en: The gears are always spinning; before one can lock to the output shaft their speeds must match. A cone-shaped friction ring drags the gear to the same speed, then the sleeve's dog teeth slide in.

specific.zh: 這組負責 1-2 檔。輪轂固定在輸出軸上，套筒可以左右滑；兩邊各一個同步環對著各自的齒輪。
specific.en: This set serves 1st-2nd. The hub is fixed to the output shaft and the sleeve slides either way; a synchro ring on each side faces its gear.

commonIssues.zh: 同步環磨損：換某一檔會打齒。
commonIssues.en: Worn synchro ring: that gear grinds on engagement.

universal.zh: 齒輪一直在轉，要「咬」上輸出軸前，轉速得先一樣。同步器用一個錐形摩擦環先把齒輪拖到同速，再讓套筒的犬齒卡進去。
universal.en: The gears are always spinning; before one can lock to the output shaft their speeds must match. A cone-shaped friction ring drags the gear to the same speed, then the sleeve's dog teeth slide in.

specific.zh: 這組負責 3-4 檔。輪轂固定在輸出軸上，套筒可以左右滑；兩邊各一個同步環對著各自的齒輪。
specific.en: This set serves 3rd-4th. The hub is fixed to the output shaft and the sleeve slides either way; a synchro ring on each side faces its gear.

commonIssues.zh: 同步環磨損：換某一檔會打齒。
commonIssues.en: Worn synchro ring: that gear grinds on engagement.

universal.zh: 齒輪一直在轉，要「咬」上輸出軸前，轉速得先一樣。同步器用一個錐形摩擦環先把齒輪拖到同速，再讓套筒的犬齒卡進去。
universal.en: The gears are always spinning; before one can lock to the output shaft their speeds must match. A cone-shaped friction ring drags the gear to the same speed, then the sleeve's dog teeth slide in.

specific.zh: 這組負責 5-6 檔。輪轂固定在輸出軸上，套筒可以左右滑；兩邊各一個同步環對著各自的齒輪。
specific.en: This set serves 5th-6th. The hub is fixed to the output shaft and the sleeve slides either way; a synchro ring on each side faces its gear.

commonIssues.zh: 同步環磨損：換某一檔會打齒。
commonIssues.en: Worn synchro ring: that gear grinds on engagement.

universal.zh: 六個檔位齒輪空套在輸出軸上，平常自由轉。同步器把其中一個鎖住，動力才從副軸經那對齒輪到輸出軸。
universal.en: Six gears ride freely on the output shaft. When a synchroniser locks one of them, power flows from the countershaft through that pair to the output.

specific.zh: BMW 手排是「三軸」布局嗎？不是，GS6 是典型的兩軸縱置手排：輸入軸、副軸、輸出軸同心於輸入軸。
specific.en: The GS6 is a conventional two-shaft longitudinal layout: input shaft, countershaft, and an output shaft in line with the input.

universal.zh: 一根整支加工出來的齒輪軸，永遠跟著輸入軸轉。它和輸出軸上的每個檔位齒輪都常嚙合。
universal.en: A single shaft with gears machined on it, always turning with the input. It meshes constantly with every gear on the output shaft.

specific.zh: 六檔是直接檔或超速檔（待查證），所以副軸的齒輪大小順序就是齒比的來源。
specific.en: Whether 6th is direct or overdrive is unverified; the sizes of the countershaft gears are what set the ratios.

universal.zh: 一個鎖在飛輪上的鐵殼，裡面的膜片彈簧把離合器片壓在飛輪上。踩離合器就是把彈簧指壓進去，讓壓力消失。
universal.en: A cover bolted to the flywheel; its diaphragm spring clamps the clutch disc to the flywheel. Pressing the pedal pushes the spring fingers in and the clamping force disappears.

specific.zh: BMW 的離合器片、壓板、分離軸承通常整組換（套件）。壓板螺絲要對角、分段鎖。
specific.en: BMW clutch disc, pressure plate and release bearing are usually replaced as a kit. Tighten the cover bolts in a cross pattern, in stages.

fasteners.desc: 壓板螺絲 / Pressure plate bolts

warnings.zh: 鬆螺絲要對角分段，否則壓板殼會變形。
warnings.en: Loosen in a cross pattern in stages or the cover warps.

universal.zh: 兩面有摩擦材料的圓盤，中心花鍵套在輸入軸上。被壓板夾緊時跟飛輪一起轉，把動力帶進變速箱；放開就打滑、分離。
universal.en: A disc with friction material on both faces, splined to the input shaft at its centre. Clamped, it turns with the flywheel and carries power into the gearbox; released, it slips and disconnects.

specific.zh: 離合器片有方向性（通常印 flywheel side / gearbox side）。裝回時用校正棒對中，否則變速箱裝不上去。
specific.en: The disc has a direction (marked flywheel side / gearbox side). Centre it with an alignment tool or the gearbox will not go on.

warnings.zh: 摩擦材料沾到油就報廢。
warnings.en: Friction material contaminated with oil is scrap.

commonIssues.zh: 離合器打滑：轉速上升車速不跟；離合器抖動：起步時車身抖。
commonIssues.en: Slipping clutch: revs rise but speed does not. Judder: shaking on take-off.

universal.zh: 飛輪是曲軸尾端的大鐵盤，儲存轉動慣量讓引擎怠速平順，外圈齒圈給起動馬達咬。雙質量飛輪把它分成兩片，中間用彈簧連接，吸收引擎的扭轉震動，所以手排車才不會在低轉嗡嗡響。
universal.en: The flywheel is the heavy disc on the crank tail that smooths idle and carries the ring gear for the starter. A dual-mass flywheel splits it in two with springs between, absorbing torsional vibration so the gearbox does not rattle at low rpm.

specific.zh: N20 手排用雙質量飛輪（DMF）。它的彈簧會老化，壞了會有怠速咔咔聲、起步抖。飛輪螺絲是一次性（待查證）。
specific.en: The N20 manual uses a dual-mass flywheel. Its springs wear, giving an idle rattle and take-off judder. The bolts are single-use (unverified).

warnings.zh: 很重，拆最後一顆螺絲前先扶好。
warnings.en: It is heavy; support it before the last bolt comes out.

commonIssues.zh: 雙質量飛輪鬆曠：怠速金屬咔咔聲、熄火時咚一聲。
commonIssues.en: Worn DMF: metallic rattle at idle and a clunk on shutdown.

universal.zh: 踏板推總泵，總泵把煞車油壓送到分泵。油路是封閉的，所以踏板行程和分泵行程成比例。
universal.en: The pedal pushes the master cylinder, which sends brake fluid pressure to the slave. The circuit is sealed, so pedal travel maps to slave travel.

specific.zh: BMW 離合器油和煞車油共用同一個油壺。離合器系統每兩年隨煞車油一起換（待查證週期）。
specific.en: BMW shares one reservoir between clutch and brakes. The clutch fluid is changed with the brake fluid every two years (interval unverified).

name.zh: ZF 八速自排變速箱 GA8HP45

universal.zh: 自排箱靠油壓工作：扭力變換器用液體把動力傳進來，幾組行星齒輪負責變速，離合器組決定哪一組被鎖住，閥體與電腦負責換檔。駕駛不用踩離合器。
universal.en: An automatic works on oil pressure: a torque converter couples the engine with fluid, planetary gearsets change the ratio, clutch packs decide which set is held, and the valve body and computer do the shifting. No clutch pedal.

specific.zh: F30 320i N20 自排是 ZF 8HP45（BMW 料號 24009487562，社群來源）。4 組行星齒輪 + 2 個煞車（A、B）+ 3 個離合器（C、D、E），每個檔位同時接合 3 個，所以只有 5 個換檔元件就有 8 速。
specific.en: The F30 320i N20 automatic is the ZF 8HP45 (BMW part no. 24009487562, community source). Four planetary sets, two brakes (A, B) and three clutches (C, D, E); three are engaged in every gear, so just five elements give eight speeds.

fasteners.desc: 鐘形殼對引擎螺絲 / Bellhousing-to-engine bolts
驅動盤對扭力變換器螺絲 / Flexplate-to-converter bolts

warnings.zh: 退出時扭力變換器要留在變速箱上，用一片鐵片或束帶固定住，掉下來會傷油泵。
warnings.en: Keep the torque converter on the gearbox as it comes out; strap it in place or it slides off and damages the pump.

commonIssues.zh: 換檔頓挫、D 檔延遲：常見是機電單元（mechatronic）套筒漏油或 ATF 老化。
commonIssues.en: Harsh shifts or delayed engagement into D: often the mechatronic sleeve leaking or aged ATF.

specs.value: 2 煞車 + 3 離合器 / 2 brakes + 3 clutches

note.zh: ZF 稱終身油，許多車主每 8–10 萬公里換；型號請以原廠資料為準
note.en: ZF calls it lifetime fill; many owners change it every 80–100k km. Confirm the fluid spec with BMW data

universal.zh: 一個裝滿油的甜甜圈：引擎轉泵輪，油被甩向渦輪，渦輪再帶動變速箱。中間的導輪讓低速時扭力放大。因為是用油傳，怠速踩煞車引擎也不會熄火。
universal.en: A doughnut full of oil: the engine spins the pump, oil is flung onto the turbine, and the turbine drives the gearbox. A stator in between multiplies torque at low speed. Because it is fluid, the engine does not stall when you hold the brake at idle.

specific.zh: 8HP 的扭力變換器有鎖定離合器，巡航時直接把泵輪和渦輪鎖死，不再打滑，省油。它跟變速箱一起退出，用螺絲從驅動盤上分開。
specific.en: The 8HP converter has a lock-up clutch that ties pump and turbine together when cruising, so there is no slip and better economy. It comes out with the gearbox after being unbolted from the flexplate.

warnings.zh: 裡面的油倒不乾淨，換油時這裡會留一半舊油。
warnings.en: It never drains fully; about half the old fluid stays in it on a fluid change.

universal.zh: 由扭力變換器殼直接帶動的油泵，引擎一轉就供油壓。沒油壓，自排箱什麼都做不了，所以自排車不能用推的發動。
universal.en: A pump driven directly by the converter housing, so there is pressure as soon as the engine turns. Without pressure an automatic can do nothing, which is why you cannot push-start one.

specific.zh: 8HP 的油泵由鏈條帶動、偏置在軸線旁（待查證）。模擬器畫成同軸示意。
specific.en: The 8HP pump is chain-driven and offset from the main axis (unverified); the simulator draws it coaxial for simplicity.

universal.zh: 變速箱底下的油槽，濾網把油裡的碎屑擋住。
universal.en: The sump under the gearbox; the filter strains debris from the fluid.

specific.zh: 8HP 的油底殼是塑膠的，濾網做在裡面，所以換油就是換整個油底殼（含新濾網與墊片）。螺絲是鋁製一次性（待查證）。
specific.en: The 8HP pan is plastic with the filter moulded in, so a fluid service means replacing the whole pan (filter and gasket included). The bolts are aluminium and single-use (unverified).

warnings.zh: 加油要在規定油溫下用油位螺絲確認，溫度不對油位就不對。
warnings.en: Fluid level is set at a specified temperature through the level plug; the wrong temperature gives the wrong level.

name.zh: 機電單元（閥體 + 電腦）

universal.zh: 閥體是一塊佈滿油道的鋁板，電磁閥決定油壓送到哪個離合器。電腦（TCU）依車速、油門、油溫決定什麼時候換檔。
universal.en: The valve body is an aluminium plate full of passages; solenoids route pressure to each clutch. The control unit decides when to shift from speed, throttle and fluid temperature.

specific.zh: ZF 把閥體和電腦做成一個「機電單元」裝在油底殼裡。接頭套筒（sleeve）老化漏油是 8HP 常見毛病。
specific.en: ZF combines valve body and computer into one mechatronic unit inside the pan. A leaking connector sleeve is a common 8HP fault.

warnings.zh: 拆接頭時注意不要讓油流進插頭。
warnings.en: Keep fluid out of the connector when unplugging it.

commonIssues.zh: 機電套筒漏油、電磁閥故障：換檔頓挫、故障碼。
commonIssues.en: Leaking sleeve or failed solenoid: harsh shifts and fault codes.

universal.zh: 最後面的殼，裝著輸出軸軸承、油封與停車鎖。
universal.en: The rearmost casing, holding the output bearing, seal and park lock.

specific.zh: 模擬器把它當作打開自排箱的入口。
specific.en: The simulator treats it as the door into the automatic.

universal.zh: 變速箱的出口，傳動軸鎖在這裡。
universal.en: The gearbox outlet; the driveshaft bolts here.

specific.zh: 拆傳動軸（P4）時從這裡分開。
specific.en: The driveshaft (P4) separates here.

universal.zh: 一疊交錯的鋼片和摩擦片，油壓推活塞把它們壓在一起就「接合」。煞車（brake）把某個元件固定在殼上，離合器（clutch）把兩個轉動的元件鎖在一起。
universal.en: A stack of alternating steel and friction plates; oil pressure on a piston squeezes them together to engage. A brake holds a member to the case; a clutch locks two rotating members together.

specific.zh: 8HP 有 A、B 兩個煞車和 C、D、E 三個離合器。每個檔位接合其中 3 個：1 檔 ABC、2 檔 ABE、3 檔 BCE、4 檔 BDE、5 檔 BCD、6 檔 CDE、7 檔 ACD、8 檔 ADE、倒檔 ABD（社群來源：Wikipedia）。
specific.en: The 8HP has brakes A and B and clutches C, D and E. Three engage in each gear: 1st ABC, 2nd ABE, 3rd BCE, 4th BDE, 5th BCD, 6th CDE, 7th ACD, 8th ADE, reverse ABD (community source: Wikipedia).

universal.zh: 每組有太陽齒輪、幾個行星齒輪、行星架和外圈齒輪。固定其中一個、驅動另一個，第三個就以不同比例轉。幾組串起來就有很多種齒比。
universal.en: Each set has a sun gear, several planet gears on a carrier, and a ring gear. Hold one member, drive another, and the third turns at a different ratio. Several sets in series give many ratios.

specific.zh: 8HP 用 4 組行星齒輪（Lepelletier 以外的 ZF 自家設計）。齒比 1 檔 4.714 到 8 檔 0.667（社群來源）。
specific.en: The 8HP uses four planetary sets in ZF's own layout. Ratios run from 4.714 in 1st to 0.667 in 8th (community source).

universal.zh: 自排車沒有飛輪，用一片薄鋼板把曲軸和扭力變換器連起來，外圈有起動馬達用的齒圈。它可以微微彎曲，吸收扭力變換器的軸向移動。
universal.en: An automatic has no flywheel; a thin steel plate links the crank to the converter and carries the starter ring gear. It flexes slightly to absorb the converter's axial movement.

specific.zh: 驅動盤對扭力變換器的螺絲要從鐘形殼的檢修孔，一顆一顆轉曲軸來鎖。螺絲一次性（待查證）。
specific.en: The flexplate-to-converter bolts are reached through an access hole, turning the crank to bring each one round. Bolts are single-use (unverified).
